label: A CONTINGENT_1 actual CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 being populates the route's world (Cogito node)
meaning: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): the contingency node's witness is concrete and exists at w, so the route's population node holds. It puts the node on the root path as an alternative derivation of STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD; as an assembly it closes that node only if the contingency node is closed (invariant 16 fixpoint). It is registered as a strengthens relation (strong: the contingency node; weak: the population node); since 2026-11-12 a registration still counts for reach, so the node stays on the root path, while closure sets the argument aside and closes the weak version only by strength-order propagation. The converse fails (CONTINGENT-NODE-CONTROLS: on the one-world frame the world is inhabited and no being is contingent).
